items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Well, Martha and Rogelio. ... Anisa, Estela, Graciela, ahh Marta y Rogelio. ... There was Estela, there was Graciel, there was Rogelio, Jr. and Martha.

ctx.x: Okay, and what was your mother and father's name?
